author: GPT / Codex (小典)

model.seed_formula: first 32 hex characters of SHA256('aquarium-next-economy-v1:' + zero-based sample index)
model.quantiles: nearest-rank: sorted[ceil(p*n)-1]; 16 seeds are a small sensitivity sample, not player estimates
model.rod_note: Internal 0..4 only; UI labels may differ. Higher rod shortens catch period; it does not multiply per-fish coins.
model.fixed_capability_note: Water access and rod level are set on synthetic valid states without paying unlock/upgrade costs. This is NOT a new-player progression simulation.
model.initial_inventory: Actual initial grant (one pond_blue); income excludes all initial coins. Each scenario fixes one water and an empty 4-slot display.
model.retention: owned_count - max(4, displayed_count), clamped at zero; limited species excluded
model.stockpile_note: Cashout value is the alternative end-only sale total, not an additional income on top of daily sales. No pre-existing real-player stockpile is assumed.
model.comparison_scope: Daily vs end-only equality holds for unchanged prices/display reserve and no spending or purchases affecting catches; receipt timestamps/counts need not match.

affordability_note: Illustrative coin costs only, not approved prices. Constant mature capability, full book, limited caps exhausted, each 24h visited, zero other spending; excludes unlock conditions and starting savings.
